verdict.rationale: Missive's own homepage claims teams can "collaborate behind the scenes" on shared conversations. A community user also says they collaborate directly in a thread rather than forwarding, which points to internal discussion attached to an email. However, the evidence never documents per-conversation internal comments or @mentions; team chat and co-drafting are separate features and are not credited. missing for 10: explicit documentation of internal comments on an email conversation, @mention support and notifications, hands-on corroboration of the side-thread workflow.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around

citations.quote: See what’s going on, know who’s doing what, and collaborate behind the scenes — without changing your workflow.
they want to collaborate directly in a thread, as Missive's collaborative writing allows
